nodes.name: Schedule_Trigger_15Min
nodes.notes: Autonomous 15-minute scheduler checking for upcoming confirmed appointments needing reminders

parameters.query:
WITH eligible AS (
      SELECT
        a.appointment_id,
        d.doctor_name,
        d.timezone,
        a.customer_name,
        a.phone,
        a.doctor_id,
        a.service,
        a.start_time,
        a.end_time,
        a.status,
        CASE
          WHEN a.start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '72 hours'
               AND a.start_time > NOW()
               AND a.reminder_3d_sent = FALSE
               AND (a.reminder_3d_claimed_at IS NULL OR a.reminder_3d_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes')
            THEN '3D'
          WHEN a.start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours'
               AND a.start_time > NOW()
               AND a.reminder_1d_sent = FALSE
               AND (a.reminder_1d_claimed_at IS NULL OR a.reminder_1d_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes')
            THEN '1D'
          WHEN a.start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '4 hours'
               AND a.start_time > NOW()
               AND a.reminder_4h_sent = FALSE
               AND (a.reminder_4h_claimed_at IS NULL OR a.reminder_4h_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes')
            THEN '4H'
          WHEN a.start_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '1 hour'
               AND a.start_time > NOW()
               AND a.reminder_1h_sent = FALSE
               AND (a.reminder_1h_claimed_at IS NULL OR a.reminder_1h_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes')
            THEN '1H'
          ELSE NULL
        END AS tier
      FROM appointments a
      JOIN doctors d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id
      WHERE a.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'RESCHEDULED')
        AND a.start_time > NOW()
      FOR UPDATE OF a SKIP LOCKED
    ),
    valid_due AS (
      SELECT * FROM eligible WHERE tier IS NOT NULL
    )
    UPDATE appointments a
    SET
      reminder_3d_claimed_at = CASE WHEN v.tier = '3D' THEN NOW() ELSE a.reminder_3d_claimed_at END,
      reminder_1d_claimed_at = CASE WHEN v.tier = '1D' THEN NOW() ELSE a.reminder_1d_claimed_at END,
      reminder_4h_claimed_at = CASE WHEN v.tier = '4H' THEN NOW() ELSE a.reminder_4h_claimed_at END,
      reminder_1h_claimed_at = CASE WHEN v.tier = '1H' THEN NOW() ELSE a.reminder_1h_claimed_at END,
      updated_at = NOW()
    FROM valid_due v
    WHERE a.appointment_id = v.appointment_id
      AND a.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'RESCHEDULED')
      AND (
        (v.tier = '3D' AND a.reminder_3d_sent = FALSE AND (a.reminder_3d_claimed_at IS NULL OR a.reminder_3d_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'))
        OR (v.tier = '1D' AND a.reminder_1d_sent = FALSE AND (a.reminder_1d_claimed_at IS NULL OR a.reminder_1d_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'))
        OR (v.tier = '4H' AND a.reminder_4h_sent = FALSE AND (a.reminder_4h_claimed_at IS NULL OR a.reminder_4h_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'))
        OR (v.tier = '1H' AND a.reminder_1h_sent = FALSE AND (a.reminder_1h_claimed_at IS NULL OR a.reminder_1h_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'))
      )
    RETURNING
      a.appointment_id, a.customer_name, a.phone, a.doctor_id, a.service,
      a.start_time, a.end_time, a.status,
      v.doctor_name, v.timezone, v.tier AS reminder_tier,
      CASE
        WHEN v.tier = '3D' THEN a.reminder_3d_claimed_at
        WHEN v.tier = '1D' THEN a.reminder_1d_claimed_at
        WHEN v.tier = '4H' THEN a.reminder_4h_claimed_at
        WHEN v.tier = '1H' THEN a.reminder_1h_claimed_at
      END AS claimed_at;

nodes.name: Send_WhatsApp_Reminder
nodes.notes: Only flows to Mark_Sent upon verified HTTP 200 WhatsApp delivery

parameters.query:
UPDATE appointments
    SET reminder_3d_sent = CASE WHEN $1 = '3D' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_3d_sent END,
        reminder_1d_sent = CASE WHEN $1 = '1D' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_1d_sent END,
        reminder_4h_sent = CASE WHEN $1 = '4H' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_4h_sent END,
        reminder_1h_sent = CASE WHEN $1 = '1H' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_1h_sent END,
        reminder_3d_claimed_at = CASE WHEN $1 = '3D' THEN NULL ELSE reminder_3d_claimed_at END,
        reminder_1d_claimed_at = CASE WHEN $1 = '1D' THEN NULL ELSE reminder_1d_claimed_at END,
        reminder_4h_claimed_at = CASE WHEN $1 = '4H' THEN NULL ELSE reminder_4h_claimed_at END,
        reminder_1h_claimed_at = CASE WHEN $1 = '1H' THEN NULL ELSE reminder_1h_claimed_at END,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE appointment_id = $2
      AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
      AND (
        ($1 = '3D' AND reminder_3d_sent = FALSE AND reminder_3d_claimed_at IS NOT NULL)
        OR ($1 = '1D' AND reminder_1d_sent = FALSE AND reminder_1d_claimed_at IS NOT NULL)
        OR ($1 = '4H' AND reminder_4h_sent = FALSE AND reminder_4h_claimed_at IS NOT NULL)
        OR ($1 = '1H' AND reminder_1h_sent = FALSE AND reminder_1h_claimed_at IS NOT NULL)
      )
    RETURNING *;
